stem.en: A rare disease has a true prevalence of 1 in 10,000 people. A test for it has 99% sensitivity and 99% specificity. Why can most people who test positive on this test still NOT have the disease, despite the test's high accuracy?
stem.et: Harval haigusel on tegelik levimus 1 juhtum 10 000 inimese kohta. Selle jaoks mõeldud testil on 99% tundlikkus ja 99% spetsiifilisus. Miks võib enamikul inimestel, kes selle testiga positiivselt testivad, siiski SEDA haigust MITTE olla, hoolimata testi kõrgest täpsusest?

label.en: Because the pool of healthy people being tested is so much larger than the pool of people with the rare disease that even the test's small 1% false-positive rate among that huge healthy majority produces more false positives in absolute numbers than the true positives found among the tiny diseased minority.
label.et: Sest testitavate tervete inimeste hulk on nii palju suurem kui harva haigusega inimeste hulk, et isegi testi väike 1% valepositiivsuse määr selle tohutu terve enamuse seas toodab absoluutarvudes rohkem valepositiivseid kui tõelisi positiivseid, mis leitakse pisikesest haigest vähemusest.

label.en: It can't — a 99% sensitive and 99% specific test guarantees that a positive result is 99% likely to be a true positive, regardless of how rare the disease is.
label.et: See ei saa nii olla -- 99% tundlikkuse ja 99% spetsiifilisusega test tagab, et positiivne tulemus on 99% tõenäosusega tõeline positiivne, sõltumata sellest, kui harv haigus on.

label.en: Because sensitivity and specificity are fixed properties of the disease itself, and this particular rare disease simply has an unusually high natural false-positive rate.
label.et: Sest tundlikkus ja spetsiifilisus on haiguse enda fikseeritud omadused ning sellel konkreetsel harval haigusel on lihtsalt ebatavaliselt kõrge loomulik valepositiivsuse määr.

label.en: Because the test's designers made an error by not minimizing the total number of false positives and false negatives equally, which any well-designed test should always do.
label.et: Sest testi loojad tegid vea, jättes valepositiivsete ja valenegatiivsete koguarvu võrdselt minimeerimata, mida iga hästi disainitud test peaks alati tegema.
